title: Wilt Chamberlain's birth chart
metaDescription: Wilt Chamberlain's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 28.4° Leo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 28.4° Leo, in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 28.4° of Leo is the Sun's exact seat — third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Mars in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 21.9° Virgo, Venus at 13.0° Virgo, Mars at 7.3° Leo. Mercury in an earth sign reads as thought with its feet on the ground; Venus in an earth sign reads as attraction that grows by reliability; Mars in a fire sign reads as effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Jupiter and Neptune — a square holding at 1.1°. Right angles are where the scheme puts its grit. A square asks two functions to work in a mode neither would have chosen. Behind it, Mercury opposition Saturn at 1.2°, and Venus square Jupiter at 1.7° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. All of it stands whatever the hour was: each angle was tested from midnight to midnight before it was written down.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: Saturn opposes Neptune while both square Jupiter. Two squares braced against one opposition make a t-square — the chart’s working end, where pressure keeps finding the same outlet. The Sun makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags four placements in this chart. The Sun in Leo at 28.4° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mercury in Virgo at 21.9° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Venus in Virgo at 13.0° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Jupiter in Sagittarius at 14.8° is in domicile. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The honest balance sheet uses the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: earth 4, fire 3, water 2, air 1 across the elements, and mutable 5, fixed 3, cardinal 2 across the modalities. Saturn and Uranus were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Libra for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 11.9° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 19.3°.
